fact: The Ministry of Health's annual report for fiscal year 2023-24 states that in 2023 the expansion of DHIS2 Mobile to the 24 remaining districts, with 1,560 clerks trained, gave full coverage across the country and allows all health centres to enter data directly into DHIS2, where previously health centres sent data to district offices for entry; it gives no count of health centres actually entering, and reports HMIS dataset completeness of 92.2% in 2023 alongside unreliable internet and power at many remote health centres delaying entry.
title: Health Sector Annual Progress Report for the 2023-24 Fiscal Year
